Limitations

  • A suite written by an extension's author describes intended behavior; it is not independent evidence.
  • Trajectories stay private; the report carries their digests.
  • Metric aggregations are named ext-eval.v1 operations, not DefinitionRefs.
  • Scored with the extension only and excluded from the change: map-only.
